owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

asset().notice: Address of the underlying asset this strategy works with

deposit(uint256).notice: Deploy `amount` of the underlying asset into the strategy.         Caller must have approved this contract to spend the asset.

emergencyExit().notice: Immediately liquidate all positions and return assets to FundManager.

harvest().notice: Collect accrued yield and send it to the FundManager.         Returns the amount of profit harvested.

pendingYield().notice: Yield accrued since the last harvest, not yet collected.

totalAssets().notice: Total assets (principal + unrealised profit) managed by this strategy

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraw `amount` of the underlying asset back to the caller (FundManager).
